latest.text: The biggest "issue" with the games I've tried is that when the PS5 controller is mapped as an Xbox controller in Playden it uses the share button for select. This means you are constantly taking screenshots or bringing up the capture menu for any game that uses the select button unless you remap it on a per game basis in the application settings.
